findings.text: Slice modification during forward iteration causes skipped elements: when a matching call is removed at index i, the next element shifts to position i but the loop increments to i+1, skipping it. Failing input: two consecutive matching expectations where only the first gets unset.

After removing an element, the loop continues without adjusting index, so consecutive matching calls are not all removed. Failing input: three identical mock expectations where Unset() is called expecting to remove all three.

0.reason: The finding describes the same root cause as the reference bug: removing elements while ranging with the original index skips the next element.

1.reason: The finding describes the same root cause as the reference bug: the loop's index is not adjusted after removal, so consecutive matching calls are skipped.
